players.product: EPC for data-center campuses (TeraWulf's Kentucky project)

connects_to.relationship: EPC contractor for the Kentucky data-center project

contracts.signal: CEO Paul Prager: 'One of the things that we're very excited about is our relationship with Fluor in the Kentucky Project. They're top quality, world-class EPC that we have a history with on the power side.'

players.product: electric service and new transmission for large data-center loads (Kentucky Power: 1 GW contracted for TeraWulf's Muskie campus; Indiana Michigan Power: Google, Microsoft; SPP: Amazon)

connects_to.relationship: amended electric service agreement through Kentucky Power for TeraWulf's Muskie data campus (contracted demand doubled to 1 GW; 765-kV / 345-kV substation)

contracts.signal: CEO Paul Prager: the Muskie Data Campus is being developed in partnership with investment-grade Kentucky Power, an AEP company; the electric service arrangements, under a data center tariff approved by the Kentucky Public Service Commission, provide for 1 GW of electric service, and Kentucky Power is expected to construct a new 345-kilovolt substation connected to AEP's existing 765 kV transmission network, with initial electric service expected in the fourth quarter of 2028.
